metadata.title: Moody Portrait with Centered Serif Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A moody, low-key portrait featuring a centered subject and classic serif typography overlaid on the torso area.
triggerTerms: low-key portrait with centered serif text
excludeWhen: action or high-motion photography is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a male subject seated in a dark, textured environment. The lighting is directional, creating deep shadows and highlighting facial features. The color palette is dominated by dark greens, browns, and blacks. Typography is centered over the subject's chest, utilizing a high-contrast serif font for the name and a smaller italicized serif for the title.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered horizontally with head slightly tilted
Typography anchored to the vertical center of the torso
Muted, earthy background textures contrasting with the subject's dark clothing
Low-key lighting creating a somber, introspective mood

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot, subject occupies the central vertical third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the centered typography act as dual focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the face, moves down to the centered text, and then explores the textured background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows and dark background elements provide significant negative space around the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns in the clothing and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted olive greens and ochre in the textured background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and off-white typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between highlights and shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast uppercase serif paired with a delicate, wide-tracked italic serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic proportions and high contrast suitable for the display role.
Elegant and readable for the wide-tracked subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a moody, low-key portrait of a man in a dark striped shirt, seated against a textured dark green and brown wall. Use directional lighting to create deep shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered, off-white serif text over the torso. The main name should be in uppercase with wide tracking. Below it, add a subtitle in a smaller, wide-tracked italic serif.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting low-key with deep shadows?
Does the typography use a high-contrast serif?
Is the color palette muted and earthy?

mustRedesign: Avoid using any specific artist signatures or logos
Ensure the text is not a direct transcription of the original
postGenerationChecks: Check for legibility of white text against dark clothing
Ensure the subject's gaze is directed towards the camera
Verify the texture of the background is visible but not distracting
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Low-Key Lighting + Centered Serif Typography + Earth Tones
